'''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''' was a historical compendium created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi historian|historian]] [[Tionne Solusar]] around the year [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. Collected from a vast array of sources, including ancient artifacts, as well as personal accounts given by a great many [[Sentience/Legends|beings]], Solusar's compendium is a compilation of all of her finds, and details the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and its place within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from the days of the [[Je'daii Order]] to the [[New Jedi Order]]. By [[130 ABY]], it was recovered by the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Ellu Viss]] following the [[Massacre at Ossus]].<ref name="JvS" />
